title: EF Core Migrations using CLI
description: Learn .NET Core CLI commands for EF Core migrations.

data.text: The .NET Core CLI tools for EF Core perform design-time development tasks such as migrations, script generation, and scaffolding.

data.title: Install dotnet-ef
data.content: Installing EF Core CLI tools globally

data.title: Common Commands
data.content: Frequently used EF Core CLI commands
data.code:
# Add migration
dotnet ef migrations add MigrationName

# Update database
dotnet ef database update

# Remove last migration
dotnet ef migrations remove

# List migrations
dotnet ef migrations list

# Generate SQL script
dotnet ef migrations script

# Drop database
dotnet ef database drop

# Scaffold DbContext
dotnet ef dbcontext scaffold "connectionString" Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Install with dotnet tool install --global dotnet-ef
Three main commands: database, dbcontext, migrations
data.takeaway: Continue to learn about PMC commands.
